generated_for: Route One Surfboards official named standup catalog

brands.name: Route One Surfboards
brands.short_description: Custom surfboards by Malachi Boyce in Monterey, California.

models.name: The Dirty Harry Short
models.description: This is a shorter, wider, thicker version of the OG Dirty Harry model. A wide point forward, full thickness performance board meant to be ridden 2” shorter and a 1/4” wider than the original. This board was one of our first spring time favorites. Deep single all the way through with a lot of tail flip, combined with a low nose rocker makes this board flashy and fun, with a lot of the same performance features you would expect from the DH line. Available in squash and swallow. Average dimensions 5-8 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/4 at 26 liters.

models.name: The Explorer
models.description: The Explorer is an all around performance board engineered to fit a wide variety of conditions. Full plan shape down to a pulled in pintail. Low rocker with a little bit of tail flip. Relatively flat overall. This board paddles like a dream. However, this board can still fit any curve and any wave face from small mushy waves, to 6 foot barrels. Meant to be ridden as a shorter relaxed performance drivers, or even as long as your height for a very user friendly platform to get to know surfing. Progressive surfers should ride this board 6 inches shorter than their height, and 1 liter more volume than a normal shortboard.

models.name: The Ham Air
models.description: A performance shorty that holds on rail, but creates the perfect platform for big airs. Based on our standard shortboard the Ham 2.0. We lowered the entry rocker just a touch, widened the nose quite a bit the liven up the speed box under your front foot, and added a little tail kick to get that “Click” off the tail right before you hit the lip. This is a shortboard for ramps. This board has a lot more foam up front with a wider plan shape. Stock average dimension 5-7 x 19 x 2 1/4 @ 26liters.

models.name: The Promnight
models.description: For when its time to step it up, and try to score. This board has a lot of rocker and a lot of performance. But don’t let that fool you it still paddles. The intent of this board is to shorten up the radius and make a 6-8 feel like a 6-3 when the wall accommodates, but still lock in the barrel with a more forward stance as well. More foam in the rear of this board helps the wave pick you up from deep, but it also allows the board to project and drive like a shortboard. This board is a spicy and thin performance board for those days when its really hollow, or big lined up walls. Average Dims: 6-8 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/2.

models.name: The Stranger Danger
models.description: The Stranger Danger is a shortboard we built with team rider Dane Anderson. With this board we wanted something with a lot of rocker for hard on rail performance, with a wider plan shape and more foam for more functionality as a daily driver in a wide variety of conditions. A travel savvy board, that can contest. Using the Ham as our template, we made this board with a more continuous rocker, and left the deep double to vee in the concaves to bring back the flip in the rail, and eliminated the hip. Average Dims: 5-11 x 19 x 2 7/16 at 28.5 liters.

models.name: The Throwback
models.description: The Throwback is a board we’ve been making off and on privately for a few years that just recently took shape into something really special. This is a board born in the early 2000s with a modern twist to bring it back to life. We took the Dirty Harry OG model, went narrower thinner and longer then we bent it in half. The focus of this board was projection of the bottom and out of turns to keep it moving. It does have a modern fuller plan shape and more foam under the chest then those old boards. Available currently as a squash. Average dims 5-10 x 18 1/4 x 2 1/8 at 23.5 liters. And 5-10 x 18 1/2 x 2 1/4 at 25.5 liters.

models.name: The Tuna Bunny
models.description: The Tuna Bunny is a sparky little board with a lot of performance in a groveler package. Designed as a low rocker Twin fin WITH a trailer, expect a lot of drive and speed out of this little rocket. The plan shape is full from tip to tail, a full foil with a little bit of hidden foam in the rear of the board. Low rocker helps paddle power and speed in a short package. Also available in a TriFin package with a chopped swallow tail.

models.name: The Ham 2.0
models.description: This model is an updated re-write of our original Ham and Cheese shortboard. Your average lunchbox shortboard. Following the design intent, plan shape and rocker of the original, this board is intended to be your daily driver of choice for a shortboard that can handle a wide variety of conditions. This board has a wide speed box in the outline running through the middle third of the board with a wider nose and tail, marrying up to a flat spot through the middle third of the rocker. Average Dims: 5-10 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/4 at 26 liters.

models.name: The Super Tramp
models.description: The Super Tramp is a really high performance approach to a retro plan shape. This board has a good amount of rocker, thin rails and a medium amount of foam spread evenly throughout the board. A little bit of tail flip and really deep single to double concave throughout as well. The goal was to create a fishy board, to feed that need for more foam and speed, but still have the board feel as homey and predictable as a lose performance thruster. Ride this board as short as 6 inches less than your height, and 3 liters more volume than your performance board. Average Dims: 5-5 x 19 3/4 x 2 3/8.

models.name: The Bobby Ricky
models.description: For when you just wanna go FAST. This board is all about speed, flow and agility in a short package. It carries width throughout, broken up by the flyer swallow in the tail. The narrow tail adds bite and grab, while the deck channels create hold. The rocker is flat, but curvy through the nose and tail creating a speed box effect under the front foot and release off the tail. Ride this board about 5 inches shorter than your height for intermediate surfers.

models.name: X3
models.description: The X3 is the 3rd iteration of our performance groveler. We took the classic outline of the original X-Model and combined that with foil and concaves of our TunaBunny model to make something really special. A board that paddles great, is fast and loose in the pocket, and can be ridden in anything 1-4 foot, and even pretty solid waves. Expect a lot of drive and hold from this board with a controlled release when necessary. Average dimensions: 5-5 x 19 x 2 1/4 @ 26 liters and 6-0 x 20 x 2 5/8 @ 35 liters.
